attr.title: OpenUG2 (NFS Underground 2)
attr.desc: An open-source reimplementation of the Need for Speed: Underground 2 engine. Bring your own copy of the game. Early prototype: world loading, rendering, and racing-line opponents work, and controller gameplay is not implemented yet.
attr.inst: Prepare openug2/data from your own NFSU2 installation with tools/import_nfsu2_data.py. The port ships no game data.
